lines.differs: Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: explicitly provides for reimbursement of pre-approved travel expenses at cost.
Better for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: explicitly provides for reimbursement of pre-approved travel expenses at cost.
Better for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ is the service provider receiving fee payments and expense reimbursements rather than paying them.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: confidentiality obligations expire strictly after 3 years, omitting indefinite protection for trade secrets.
Better for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: contains mutual standard confidentiality without specific client-data security restrictions or personal device download prohibitions.
Same as Al Noor Hospitality Group: imposes standard mutual confidentiality obligations and customary exceptions for non-public business and technical information.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: explicitly assigns ownership of trained models and model weights to the client upon full payment.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: explicitly assigns ownership of trained AI models and model weights to the client.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: explicitly transfers ownership of trained models and model weights to the client.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: liability for breach of confidentiality is uncapped rather than subject to the contract fee cap.
Same as Rohan Iyer: caps aggregate liability at 12 months of fees while uncapping liability for confidentiality breaches.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: liability for indemnification obligations remains capped within the 12-month fee limit.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: AtliQ's indemnity is limited to IP infringement, excluding confidentiality, data protection, and gross negligence.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: TravelHub indemnifies AtliQ for claims arising from illegal use of deliverables in addition to customer data.
Better for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: AtliQ's indemnity obligation is restricted to IP infringement rather than covering confidentiality breaches and gross negligence.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: prohibits transferring customer data outside TravelHub's cloud environment without prior written approval.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: restricts data transfers outside TravelHub's cloud environment rather than outside the UAE.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: omits the 24-hour breach notification deadline and mandatory client and regulatory audit rights.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: submits disputes to onshore Dubai Courts and omits the mandatory 30-day executive negotiation period.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: designates local Dubai courts and UAE law instead of English law and London courts.
Better for AtliQ than Northwind Logistics: designates onshore Dubai Courts and UAE law instead of LCIA arbitration in London under English law.
